subject: DI03005061

title.en: Energy Balance
Energy balance—reference state and sign

body.en:
Definition and principle

An energy balance accounts for energy entering, leaving and accumulating in a system. Heat Q is energy transferred by a temperature difference; enthalpy H=U+pV is a state property convenient for flowing streams. Choose Q positive into the system and shaft work Ws positive out.

Balance method and important conditions

For steady flow with negligible kinetic/potential changes, the heat duty minus shaft work equals outlet minus inlet enthalpy flow. Use a common reference temperature, pressure and phase. Include reaction and phase-change effects consistently and do not add reaction heat twice. An adiabatic system has Q=0; it need not have constant temperature.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

System માં આવતી, જતી તથા accumulate થતી energy નો હિસાબ Energy Balance છે. Temperature difference થી transfer થતી energy Heat Q છે; H=U+pV એટલે flowing streams માટે ઉપયોગી state property Enthalpy. Q system માં આવે ત્યારે positive અને shaft work Ws બહાર જાય ત્યારે positive લો.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Steady flow તથા negligible kinetic/potential changes માટે heat duty minus shaft work એટલે outlet minus inlet enthalpy flow. Common reference temperature, pressure તથા phase લો. Reaction તથા phase changes consistent રીતે ગણો; reaction heat બે વાર ન ઉમેરો. Adiabatic માં Q=0 છે; temperature જરૂરી નથી કે constant હોય.

title.en: Heat capacities Cp,Cv and temperature correlations
title.gu: Heat Capacities Cp,Cv તથા Temperature Correlations

h.en: Heat capacities Cp,Cv and temperature correlations
h.gu: Heat Capacities Cp,Cv તથા Temperature Correlations

body.en:
Definition and principle

Heat capacity is energy required per unit temperature rise under specified conditions. Total heat capacity has units kJ/K; specific heat capacity uses kJ/(kg K); molar heat capacity uses kJ/(kmol K) or J/(mol K). Cp and Cv are derivatives of enthalpy and internal energy, respectively.

Balance method and important conditions

For ideal gases, enthalpy depends only on temperature and molar Cp−Cv=R. Use R=8.314 kJ/(kmol K), or0.008314 kJ/(mol K), consistently with the capacity basis. A supplied Cp polynomial has dimensional coefficients and a stated temperature scale/range; substitute kelvin unless the correlation explicitly states Celsius. The temperature interval has the same numerical value in K and°C, but absolute temperatures do not.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Specified conditions હેઠળ એકમ temperature rise માટે જરૂરી energy Heat Capacity છે. Total capacity નો એકમ kJ/K, specific capacity નો kJ/(kg K) અને molar capacity નો kJ/(kmol K) અથવા J/(mol K) છે. Cp તથા Cv અનુક્રમે enthalpy તથા internal energy ના derivatives છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Ideal gas માટે enthalpy ફક્ત temperature પર આધારિત છે અને molar Cp−Cv=R છે. Capacity basis સાથે R=8.314 kJ/(kmol K) અથવા 0.008314 kJ/(mol K) consistent લો. Cp polynomial ના coefficients dimensional છે અને temperature scale/range આપેલા હોય છે. Explicit Celsius correlation ન હોય તો kelvin મૂકો. Temperature difference નું numerical value K તથા°C માં સમાન છે, absolute temperature નું નહીં.

title.en: Heat capacity of an ideal gaseous mixture
title.gu: Ideal Gaseous Mixture ની Heat Capacity

h.en: Heat capacity of an ideal gaseous mixture
h.gu: Ideal Gaseous Mixture ની Heat Capacity

body.en:
Definition and principle

The molar heat capacity of an ideal gas mixture is the mole-fraction-weighted sum of the component molar capacities at the same temperature. Mass-specific mixture capacity uses mass fractions and mass-specific component capacities.

Balance method and important conditions

Do not multiply a molar heat capacity by a mass fraction. For fixed composition, integrate each component heat capacity or the properly weighted mixture polynomial. For nonideal mixtures or composition changes, additional property/reaction effects may matter. Mean heat capacity over a finite temperature interval is the enthalpy change divided by that interval; it need not equal the capacity at the midpoint.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Ideal gas mixture ની molar heat capacity એટલે એકસરખા temperature પર component molar capacities નો mole-fraction-weighted sum. Mass-specific mixture capacity માટે mass fractions તથા component mass-specific capacities લો.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Molar heat capacity ને mass fraction સાથે ન ગુણો. Fixed composition માટે component capacities અથવા correctly weighted mixture polynomial integrate કરો. Nonideal mixture અથવા changing composition માં વધારાની property/reaction effects જરૂરી હોઈ શકે છે. Finite interval ની mean capacity એટલે enthalpy change/temperature interval; તે midpoint capacity જેટલી હોવી જરૂરી નથી.

title.en: Sensible heat and latent phase-change heats
title.gu: Sensible Heat તથા Latent Phase-change Heats

h.en: Sensible heat and latent phase-change heats
h.gu: Sensible Heat તથા Latent Phase-change Heats

body.en:
Definition and principle

Sensible heat changes temperature without a phase change. Latent heat is the enthalpy change for a specified phase transition: fusion solid→liquid, vaporization liquid→vapour and sublimation solid→vapour. The reverse transitions release the corresponding heat at the same states.

Balance method and important conditions

Split a heating path at every phase boundary: heat within a phase, add the latent heat at the transition, and then heat the next phase. Use latent heat at the stated pressure/temperature. Do not apply one liquid Cp through vaporization. Sensible gas enthalpy at constant pressure is the integral of Cp; Q equals that enthalpy change only under the declared no-other-work energy model.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Phase change વગર temperature બદલતી heat Sensible Heat છે. Specified phase transition ની enthalpy change Latent Heat છે: Fusion solid→liquid, Vaporization liquid→vapour અને Sublimation solid→vapour. Same states પર reverse transitions એટલી heat release કરે છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

દરેક phase boundary પર path split કરો: phase ની અંદર sensible heating, transition પર latent heat અને પછી next phase heating. Latent heat આપેલા pressure/temperature પર લો. Vaporization પાર એક જ liquid Cp ન વાપરો. Constant-pressure gas sensible enthalpy માટે Cp integrate કરો; declared no-other-work model માં જ Q તે enthalpy change જેટલું છે.

title.en: Reaction enthalpy and standard heats

body.en:
Definition and principle

An exothermic reaction has negative reaction enthalpy; an endothermic reaction has positive reaction enthalpy under the stated pressure/state convention. Standard heat of formation forms one mole of a compound from its elements in their reference states. Standard heat of combustion is the enthalpy change for complete combustion of a specified amount and phase of fuel.

Balance method and important conditions

Standard commonly means standard pressure1bar with a stated temperature, usually298.15 K; it does not mean all substances are gases. Only elements in their reference states have standard formation enthalpy zero. Write phase labels: liquid and gaseous water have different formation enthalpies. A reaction heat is tied to the balanced equation as written; doubling coefficients doubles the heat.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

આપેલા state/pressure convention મુજબ negative reaction enthalpy ધરાવતી reaction Exothermic અને positive ધરાવતી Endothermic છે. Elements ના reference states માંથી compound નો એક mole બનાવવાની standard enthalpy Formation Heat છે. Specified amount તથા phase ના fuel ના complete combustion ની enthalpy change Combustion Heat છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Standard માટે સામાન્ય રીતે pressure1bar અને stated temperature, ઘણીવાર 298.15 K, લેવાય છે; બધા substances gases છે એવો અર્થ નથી. Elements ના reference states માટે જ standard formation enthalpy zero છે. Phase labels લખો: liquid તથા gaseous water ની formation enthalpy જુદી છે. Reaction heat balanced equation as written માટે છે; coefficients double કરવાથી heat double થાય છે.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

title.en: Hess’s law—formation and combustion data

body.en:
Definition and principle

Hess’s law states that the enthalpy change between specified initial and final states is independent of the reaction path. Reversing a thermochemical equation reverses its heat sign; multiplying the equation multiplies its heat by the same factor.

Balance method and important conditions

Arrange equations so unwanted intermediates cancel and the sum equals the target reaction exactly. For combustion-data calculations, both routes must end in identical combustion products and phases. The signed sum of reactant combustion heats minus product combustion heats gives the target reaction heat under this common-end-state condition. Use supplied data consistently instead of mixing unrelated temperature/phase tables.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Specified initial તથા final states વચ્ચે enthalpy change reaction path થી independent છે—આ Hess’s Law છે. Thermochemical equation reverse કરતાં heat નો sign reverse થાય છે; equation multiply કરતાં heat પણ તે જ factor થી multiply થાય છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Unwanted intermediates cancel થાય અને sum target reaction જેટલો જ બને તે રીતે equations ગોઠવો. Combustion data માં બંને routes ના final products તથા phases સમાન જોઈએ. આ common-end-state condition હેઠળ reactant combustion heats નો signed sum minus product combustion heats નો sum target reaction heat આપે છે. Alag temperature/phase tables mix ન કરો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

title.en: Energy/reaction-heat calculation checklist

body.en:
Calculation workflow

State reference phase/temperature and heat sign. Check molar versus mass Cp and correlation temperature scale. Integrate temperature-dependent Cp. Split paths at phase changes. For Hess calculations reverse/multiply both reaction and heat. Use signed data and a common final state. Convert mol↔kmol and h↔s explicitly.

How to practise honestly

Rework the solved cases without seeing the answer, then compare equations, units and closure. Change one input at a time and recheck feasibility. These are study exercises, not laboratory readings.
body.gu:
Calculation Workflow

Reference phase/temperature તથા heat sign લખો. Molar/mass Cp તથા correlation ની temperature scale તપાસો. Temperature-dependent Cp integrate કરો. Phase changes પર path split કરો. Hess calculation માં reaction તથા heat બંને reverse/multiply કરો. Signed data તથા common final state લો. Mol↔kmol તથા h↔s conversions સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

પ્રમાણિક Practice કેવી રીતે કરવી

પ્રથમ answer જોયા વગર solved cases ફરી કરો. પછી equations, units તથા closure સરખાવો. એક સમયે એક input બદલીને feasibility ફરી check કરો. આ study exercises છે, laboratory readings નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Energy balance—reference state and sign.
q.gu: Energy Balance—Reference State તથા Sign ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: An energy balance accounts for energy entering, leaving and accumulating in a system. Heat Q is energy transferred by a temperature difference; enthalpy H=U+pV is a state property convenient for flowing streams. Choose Q positive into the system and shaft work Ws positive out. For steady flow with negligible kinetic/potential changes, the heat duty minus shaft work equals outlet minus inlet enthalpy flow. Use a common reference temperature, pressure and phase. Include reaction and phase-change effects consistently and do not add reaction heat twice. An adiabatic system has Q=0; it need not have constant temperature.
a.gu: System માં આવતી, જતી તથા accumulate થતી energy નો હિસાબ Energy Balance છે. Temperature difference થી transfer થતી energy Heat Q છે; H=U+pV એટલે flowing streams માટે ઉપયોગી state property Enthalpy. Q system માં આવે ત્યારે positive અને shaft work Ws બહાર જાય ત્યારે positive લો. Steady flow તથા negligible kinetic/potential changes માટે heat duty minus shaft work એટલે outlet minus inlet enthalpy flow. Common reference temperature, pressure તથા phase લો. Reaction તથા phase changes consistent રીતે ગણો; reaction heat બે વાર ન ઉમેરો. Adiabatic માં Q=0 છે; temperature જરૂરી નથી કે constant હોય.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Heat capacities Cp,Cv and temperature correlations.
q.gu: Heat Capacities Cp,Cv તથા Temperature Correlations ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Heat capacity is energy required per unit temperature rise under specified conditions. Total heat capacity has units kJ/K; specific heat capacity uses kJ/(kg K); molar heat capacity uses kJ/(kmol K) or J/(mol K). Cp and Cv are derivatives of enthalpy and internal energy, respectively. For ideal gases, enthalpy depends only on temperature and molar Cp−Cv=R. Use R=8.314 kJ/(kmol K), or0.008314 kJ/(mol K), consistently with the capacity basis. A supplied Cp polynomial has dimensional coefficients and a stated temperature scale/range; substitute kelvin unless the correlation explicitly states Celsius. The temperature interval has the same numerical value in K and°C, but absolute temperatures do not.
a.gu: Specified conditions હેઠળ એકમ temperature rise માટે જરૂરી energy Heat Capacity છે. Total capacity નો એકમ kJ/K, specific capacity નો kJ/(kg K) અને molar capacity નો kJ/(kmol K) અથવા J/(mol K) છે. Cp તથા Cv અનુક્રમે enthalpy તથા internal energy ના derivatives છે. Ideal gas માટે enthalpy ફક્ત temperature પર આધારિત છે અને molar Cp−Cv=R છે. Capacity basis સાથે R=8.314 kJ/(kmol K) અથવા 0.008314 kJ/(mol K) consistent લો. Cp polynomial ના coefficients dimensional છે અને temperature scale/range આપેલા હોય છે. Explicit Celsius correlation ન હોય તો kelvin મૂકો. Temperature difference નું numerical value K તથા°C માં સમાન છે, absolute temperature નું નહીં.

q.en: State the necessary assumptions for Cp−Cv relation for an ideal gas.
q.gu: Ideal Gas માટે Cp−Cv નો સંબંધ માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Fixed composition; ideal gas; use molar enthalpy and internal energy. Cp and Cv are molar capacities at the same temperature. R is the molar gas constant.
a.gu: Composition fixed તથા gas ideal છે. Molar enthalpy/internal energy લો. Cp તથા Cv એકસરખા temperature પરની molar capacities છે. R molar gas constant છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Heat capacity of an ideal gaseous mixture.
q.gu: Ideal Gaseous Mixture ની Heat Capacity ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: The molar heat capacity of an ideal gas mixture is the mole-fraction-weighted sum of the component molar capacities at the same temperature. Mass-specific mixture capacity uses mass fractions and mass-specific component capacities. Do not multiply a molar heat capacity by a mass fraction. For fixed composition, integrate each component heat capacity or the properly weighted mixture polynomial. For nonideal mixtures or composition changes, additional property/reaction effects may matter. Mean heat capacity over a finite temperature interval is the enthalpy change divided by that interval; it need not equal the capacity at the midpoint.
a.gu: Ideal gas mixture ની molar heat capacity એટલે એકસરખા temperature પર component molar capacities નો mole-fraction-weighted sum. Mass-specific mixture capacity માટે mass fractions તથા component mass-specific capacities લો. Molar heat capacity ને mass fraction સાથે ન ગુણો. Fixed composition માટે component capacities અથવા correctly weighted mixture polynomial integrate કરો. Nonideal mixture અથવા changing composition માં વધારાની property/reaction effects જરૂરી હોઈ શકે છે. Finite interval ની mean capacity એટલે enthalpy change/temperature interval; તે midpoint capacity જેટલી હોવી જરૂરી નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Sensible heat and latent phase-change heats.
q.gu: Sensible Heat તથા Latent Phase-change Heats ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Sensible heat changes temperature without a phase change. Latent heat is the enthalpy change for a specified phase transition: fusion solid→liquid, vaporization liquid→vapour and sublimation solid→vapour. The reverse transitions release the corresponding heat at the same states. Split a heating path at every phase boundary: heat within a phase, add the latent heat at the transition, and then heat the next phase. Use latent heat at the stated pressure/temperature. Do not apply one liquid Cp through vaporization. Sensible gas enthalpy at constant pressure is the integral of Cp; Q equals that enthalpy change only under the declared no-other-work energy model.
a.gu: Phase change વગર temperature બદલતી heat Sensible Heat છે. Specified phase transition ની enthalpy change Latent Heat છે: Fusion solid→liquid, Vaporization liquid→vapour અને Sublimation solid→vapour. Same states પર reverse transitions એટલી heat release કરે છે. દરેક phase boundary પર path split કરો: phase ની અંદર sensible heating, transition પર latent heat અને પછી next phase heating. Latent heat આપેલા pressure/temperature પર લો. Vaporization પાર એક જ liquid Cp ન વાપરો. Constant-pressure gas sensible enthalpy માટે Cp integrate કરો; declared no-other-work model માં જ Q તે enthalpy change જેટલું છે.

q.en: State the necessary assumptions for Sensible heat change of gas at constant pressure.
q.gu: Constant Pressure પર Gas નો Sensible Heat Change માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Fixed amount n of ideal gas; no reaction or phase change. For Q=ΔH, assume constant pressure with only pressure-volume work in a closed system, or steady flow without shaft work/kinetic/potential changes. Use T in the correlation’s stated scale, here kelvin. Cp=a+bT+cT²over the valid range.
a.gu: Ideal gas amount n fixed છે. Reaction/phase change નથી. Q=ΔH માટે closed system માં constant pressure તથા ફક્ત pV work, અથવા steady flow માં shaft work/kinetic/potential changes negligible લો. Correlation મુજબ temperature scale લો; અહીં kelvin છે. Valid range પર Cp=a+bT+cT² છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Reaction enthalpy and standard heats.
q.gu: Reaction Enthalpy તથા Standard Heats ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: An exothermic reaction has negative reaction enthalpy; an endothermic reaction has positive reaction enthalpy under the stated pressure/state convention. Standard heat of formation forms one mole of a compound from its elements in their reference states. Standard heat of combustion is the enthalpy change for complete combustion of a specified amount and phase of fuel. Standard commonly means standard pressure1bar with a stated temperature, usually298.15 K; it does not mean all substances are gases. Only elements in their reference states have standard formation enthalpy zero. Write phase labels: liquid and gaseous water have different formation enthalpies. A reaction heat is tied to the balanced equation as written; doubling coefficients doubles the heat.
a.gu: આપેલા state/pressure convention મુજબ negative reaction enthalpy ધરાવતી reaction Exothermic અને positive ધરાવતી Endothermic છે. Elements ના reference states માંથી compound નો એક mole બનાવવાની standard enthalpy Formation Heat છે. Specified amount તથા phase ના fuel ના complete combustion ની enthalpy change Combustion Heat છે. Standard માટે સામાન્ય રીતે pressure1bar અને stated temperature, ઘણીવાર 298.15 K, લેવાય છે; બધા substances gases છે એવો અર્થ નથી. Elements ના reference states માટે જ standard formation enthalpy zero છે. Phase labels લખો: liquid તથા gaseous water ની formation enthalpy જુદી છે. Reaction heat balanced equation as written માટે છે; coefficients double કરવાથી heat double થાય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Hess’s law—formation and combustion data.
q.gu: Hess’s Law—Formation તથા Combustion Data ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Hess’s law states that the enthalpy change between specified initial and final states is independent of the reaction path. Reversing a thermochemical equation reverses its heat sign; multiplying the equation multiplies its heat by the same factor. Arrange equations so unwanted intermediates cancel and the sum equals the target reaction exactly. For combustion-data calculations, both routes must end in identical combustion products and phases. The signed sum of reactant combustion heats minus product combustion heats gives the target reaction heat under this common-end-state condition. Use supplied data consistently instead of mixing unrelated temperature/phase tables.
a.gu: Specified initial તથા final states વચ્ચે enthalpy change reaction path થી independent છે—આ Hess’s Law છે. Thermochemical equation reverse કરતાં heat નો sign reverse થાય છે; equation multiply કરતાં heat પણ તે જ factor થી multiply થાય છે. Unwanted intermediates cancel થાય અને sum target reaction જેટલો જ બને તે રીતે equations ગોઠવો. Combustion data માં બંને routes ના final products તથા phases સમાન જોઈએ. આ common-end-state condition હેઠળ reactant combustion heats નો signed sum minus product combustion heats નો sum target reaction heat આપે છે. Alag temperature/phase tables mix ન કરો.
